basic_info.short_description: #KILLALLZOMBIES is an insane twin-stick zombie shooter with Twitch streaming interactions, where you survive hordes of zombies on a dynamically changing arena and spectators may affect gameplay via special Twitch chat commands.
Combine characters with unique abilities in this co-op puzzle game! Together they are stronger, but apart they can be in more than one place at the same time...
(Spell+Fract) a Co-Op PVE Rougelike game about using math formulas to create spells of mass destruction and the better you are, the faster you cast, the more devistating the result.

store_items.name: *NEW* FINAL SCUFFED WITH A LITTLE POLISH BHOP EXPERIENCE 2029 BRAIN ROT EDITION (POG CHAMP)

basic_info.short_description: The third and final entry in the SCUFFED BHOP trilogy. With a brand new single-player campaign and levels for players to beat and speedrun. With lots of easter eggs and (un)funny memes.

The long-awaited sequel to the hit game *NEW* SCUFFED EPIC BHOP SIMULATOR 2023 (POG CHAMP) is here! All new SinglePlayer maps with popular maps returning from the first game! Play online multiplayer cross platform with all new modes and experiences!

When a virus makes robots go rogue, you and your squad are sent in to take back control of the situation by taking on endless waves of increasingly violent synths. Go now mercenaries! Execute .synth_protocol.
Local-multiplayer arena-based race-battle-mageddon
0Gravity is a game whose action takes place in zero gravity (predictably). Confuse your opponents and anticipate their actions to win in pixel 2D levels. There can be only one space marine!

game_rating.content_survey_notes: Brutal scenes of death. Pixel, but brutal.

basic_info.short_description: You learned the rhyme when you were five. The lab learned it too. 1 MONKEY LEFT is co-op horror-comedy where every verse strips another monkey from the bed — until one of you is left, the loot is yours, and the rhyme is over.  Find out which verse takes you.
Dash, dodge, and take aim! A fresh take on arena shooters, where it only takes one shot to kill or be killed.
Online multiplayer game where deception and truth will suit up. Solve the clues, equip and use items, debate who’s the shadiest player and unmask the Killer!

The Apocalypse has arrived and your goal is simple: Make it 10 miles to safety through a limitless procedurally-generated world overrun with The Infected and packed with the tools and weapons to fight them.

10 MILLION MINIONS is a solo and co-op tower defense roguelite: tens of thousands of enemies pour down on your people. Raise your defenses, fuse your towers, then graft them onto a weapon to dominate in FPS. And watch the horde break against them.

we`ve all been down to our local bowling alley to play. But ended up having to wait for hours to get a lane. Don`t waste anymore more time, run the game up and play. No more waiting, just straight to the fun part. Multiplayer on one pc sharing your headset.
Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

100 Bodies in the Grass is a wave-based co-op defense game, set against the backdrop of the Third Mongol Invasion of Vietnam, combining elements of roguelikes and tower/hero defenses with the combat of an isometric ARPG.

game_rating.content_survey_notes: Violence typical of medieval combat, including visible blood and intentional killing.

An online coop horror game for 1–4 players. Find useful items and advance as far as possible. Complete all 100 rooms!
A die and retry with 100 levels, simple gameplay and hours of rage quit.

100 SCREAMERS is a horror about a policewoman who came to a call, but turned out to be a toy in the hands of a maniac. Will she commit terrible things to survive or will she find a way out of a hopeless situation?

game_rating.content_survey_notes: Jumpscares, blood, abduction, psychological abuse, death, corpses

basic_info.short_description: Action arcade! CAPTURE enemies of your color and AVOID the rest to become the best in the world! Fast, addictive and 100% challenging!

100% Orange Juice is a digital multiplayer board game populated by developer Orange Juice's all-star cast. Characters from Flying Red Barrel, QP Shooting, Suguri and Sora come together with all-new characters to duke it out... with dice.
Mini games you can play with your friends or with bots during any time!
A co-op road-trip adventure about covering 1000 km in rusty clunkers.

Discover the lost treasures of Ukampa in South America as Aban Hawkins searches for his estranged father, world-famous archeaologist, Jim Hawkins. Aban Hawkins races into the frozen tundra of the antarctic, undiscovered temple ruins and the vast caverns of South America in search of his father and the legendary treasure rumored to lie behind the Golden Door of Poko-Mum.

100ft Robot Golf is a fast-paced arcade golf game where you get to control impossibly large robots on their quest for par. Just swing your golf club to smash even the tallest buildings out of the way - or into the way of your robot golfing buddies.
Locked In is a two-player visual novel simulating the breakdown of a marriage during lockdown.
TENNIS HELL ARCADE
44 Challenges in a game to beat your friends.
12 orbits is the only local multiplayer game for 2-12 people at once, no matter what you play on. A single keyboard, touchscreen or controller will do.

Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

Engage in deadly shootouts with a diverse arsenal of weaponry in this fast competitive online FPS.
The objective: Get the encrypted data back to the source.
Find the encrypted key and activate the data SLOT, a pyramidal dock with the power of sending the data back to ATMOS.
Do you love those soccer games on consoles & home computers from the 90s?
17.waves is an online co-op tower defense game for up to four players. Strategize with your teammates to build, upgrade, and maintain your towers to defend your base from hordes of invading aliens.

18 Levels of Hells is a time-survival, featuring bullet-hell & roguelite elements, folklore horror & 2D pixel-art, support up to 8 multiplayer online co-op. Players kill monsters, upgrade, unlock new weapon. Boss fights feature challenging rhythm-synchronized patterns.

18Korea is an online multiplayer game for 2 to 5 players motivated by the beloved board game series '18xx'.
In the 19~20 century Korean Peninsula, Make the best profit by running railroad companies and trading stocks.
PC conversion of a turn-based hex-strategy board war game.

Space shooters never die. 1993 is a testament to that.
1993 is a classic shoot em up celebrating games like Gradius, R-Type and Life Force.
fps multi-player battle royal.

2 Bows 1 Arrow is a true co-op adventure for 2 players! You can test the strength of your connection on numerous levels by shooting a bow, BUT you share ONE arrow for TWO. Levels that require coordination of actions and logic to defeat enemis and solve numerous puzzles, await you.

2 Cooks 1 Mess is a chaotic online cooking game where you manage a team of chefs, servers and cleaners with unique skills. Cook, clean, serve and survive wild kitchen events as you climb from rookie to restaurant master.

Two children journey through worlds shaped by emotions to save their parents. Work together, solve puzzles, face strange creatures, and reverse gravity to transform the rules, gameplay, and music, either solo or in local co-op.

Agent 11 is back. The iconic tactical deck-builder returns, with new tricks up its impeccably tailored sleeves… and this time it’s with friends. Improvise within the space, adapt your deck to the challenges ahead, and overcome a roster of new enemies in stylish, animated, fight sequences.

game_rating.content_survey_notes: The game features animated scenes of violence between stylised human characters in both armed and unarmed combat. (Optionally) There are frequent sprays of blood when attacks occurs.

basic_info.short_description: A co-op game about two souls trying to escape underworld and reach heaven while controlling one adorable character.

20XX is a roguelike action platformer that you can play with a friend. Jump and shoot your way through ever-changing levels, collect awesome new powers, and battle mighty bosses in the name of saving the human race maybe!

22RS is the fastest physics-based racing game on Steam, while also pushing the boundaries of traditional racing design with it's competitive RTS mechanics.
If you like racing really fast, challenging yourself and exploring new game designs - Then this could be the game for you.
Fight against humanity. This 3d mech brawler pits you against 6 opponents before you face the ultimate boss. Use your weapon, rockets and melee abilities to defeat your opponents across 6 stages.

game_rating.content_survey_notes: The game features robots bleeding oil and exploding violently. Implied death.

basic_info.short_description: Three dimensional grid turn-based strategy game. Combat the computer or your friends to prove your brain is less smooth than theirs.
Enter the battle of Pitcher vs. Batter! Challenge the single player teams to unlock their unique pitches, then battle your friends with the fast paced competitive gameplay!

Excavate, combat, discover, construct! Every challenge can be conquered in this thrilling adventure game. Immerse yourself in endless creativity as you explore through uncharted territories , engage in epic battles  and shape thw world with your own hands.

A simple fighting game distilling the core essence of 3D fighting games! And yet, it's 2D...? Fight through a story mode featuring a cursed rat, a cotton candy monster, and evil wizards. Customise your characters with HATS!!!1!!1 and play against your friends in online lobbies with Rollback Netcode!

An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!
2KXX is a local multiplayer game. Fight your friends on a selection of various characters, maps, and game modes. Spice your Match with a list of modifiers that can make your life easier or worse.
A fast-paced 2-player competitive race across 100 ever-changing mazes. In 2mazing, every level grants you a unique set of abilities. Be the first to claim the Trophy.

2tinycowboys is an action-packed western-themed arcade multi-scrolling platformer in 2D, with huge variety, in which you take the role of one of 9 different cowboys, each with his/her own play-style. It has up to 4 players split-screen multiplayer available and quirky game-play and characters.

Top-down arcade football for the whole crew. Up to 6 players on one couch, or online with friends over Steam. Tournaments, football-tennis, penalties, minigames and legendary moments to fire up the match. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down. Grab a controller and score!

3..2..1..Grenades! is a snowball fight with high explosives. Help save Grenades Co from the terrible monster it's unleashed in this LOCAL MULTIPLAYER ADVENTURE GAME. Save the day or battle it out by yourself with bots, or with up to 4 of your friends!

You are a former patient of an abandoned asylum, waking up on the 30th floor. To escape, descend all the floors by detecting anomalies using your observation and memory. Correct choices reduce the remaining floors, but mistakes are unforgivable. Can you escape?

3079 is a futuristic, open-world action first-person role playing game. All areas, buildings, items, quests and characters are randomly generated. You will find unique lands & challenges. I hope you enjoy it!
Combining shooting with puzzles create unexpected result, which is fun(Sometimes). Play it with your friend!.
33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression. Harness brutal firepower and necromantic skills to survive.

33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.

360 No Scope is a fast pace shooter that requires skill and accuracy. Take the fun and chaos of insta-gib with the only way to get ammo is by doing a 360, plus ability to run on walls, ceilings, and you get a fun chaos deathmatch experience.

Embark on the 19th century's most unreliable spaceship in this 2 player couch co-op adventure. 39 Days to Mars is a unique game designed to be played with a friend, where both players have important roles in the expedition. Solo players are aided by the computer-controlled ship's cat.

One lake. One Grandpa. One mouth. 39 million spoons. Pour the lake into Grandpa with up to 3 friends in a physics co-op incremental game, upgrade your spoon all the way to a duck pool, and deal with a headbutting goat, a meddling mermaid and a Grandpa who keeps dozing off.

Work the night shift at a 24-hour drive-thru. Take orders, cook the food and hand it out the window. But some customers aren’t human. Check every face, car and order, and refuse the ones that don’t match, or they’ll come back for you before dawn. Solo or co-op for up to 4 players.

Zero-gravity pool, seen through a porthole in the cue ball, because that's where you are. Fifteen numbered balls float in a sealed room with a pocket in every corner. Every shot throws you backward: it's how you get around, and how you sink yourself. Solo, vs a bot, or with a friend on one screen.

3D Chess Online combines the magical world of chess with a modern and three-dimensional experience! Determine your strategy and fight against your opponents worldwide in this simulator equipped with realistic graphics.

3D Chess with new figures, new game modes and complex boards-sizes.
Play on 5x5 to 16x16 boards.
New Figures: Wizard, Gamma and Keeper.
Explore and discover a new chess.
Play online, offline or against AI
Single board games and hierarchical 3D games.
Be the one that beats the most opponents.
3D Pool brings the Pool table right to your home!
Create your own miniature world as a model railroad with tracks from popular manufacturers or as a realistic railroad simulation - in 3D!

3on3 FreeStyle: Rebound allows players to Team up for fast-paced street basketball, dive into single-player Career Mode PVE, and grow your skills with dynamic gameplay and enhanced Lumen-powered visuals.
3XTINCTION is an Online Co-op Top Down Shooter with tactical and strategic elements. You and your friends will have to cooperate in order to complete missions.

game_rating.content_survey_notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Violence, strong language and General Mature Content.

basic_info.short_description: Fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter where every run brings new upgrades, enemy waves, and ship evolutions. Play solo or team up with a friend in co-op to survive, adapt, and dominate the galaxy.

It’s just you and your crew versus an alien invasion. Odds are you’re going to die. A lot. 

Thankfully, that’s all part of The Plan.
A co-op extraction roguelike with active ragdoll chaos. Descend into ancient underground ruins, recover priceless relics, survive the unknown, and escape with enough to meet the quota... together!
Race around the world! 4PGP is a 90’s arcade-style racing game with a timeless charm and simple controls that makes it easy to pick up and play.

4Prot is an interactive prototyping laboratory that allows you to create virtual spaces for students and professionals to creatively build different types of prototypes.
The free version of 4Prot allows you to save 2 projects with 100 blocks each.

As the leader of a nation, dispatch and control your team of characters all around the world to destabilize your enemies and establish your supremacy.
All methods are fair game: hacking, sabotage, political interference, military strikes, corruption, treachery, assassinations, data theft…

game_rating.content_survey_notes:
4th Generation Warfare makes references to the following themes:

Sequences in 3D gameplay show military combat and the use of missiles, bombs, explosives or firearms: these 3D animations are not visually realistic. 
During these sequences, characters can be killed, but the 3D animations are not visually realistic.
All of these animations are seen from afar and from above and does not depict any blood.


Some images in a virtual newspaper within the game depict the following situations:
-crime scenes where the police conduct their investigation: these scenes do not show the bodies of the victims.
-the abuse of drugs in order to describe the deplorable condition of some characters. These images and associated texts always depict the negative aspects of drug use and never encourages it.
-prisoners following their arrest or capture
-military confrontations
-confrontations between police and demonstrators or gangsters

basic_info.short_description: A challenging arcade racing game with the goal of setting high scores.

A hand-drawn 2D fighter that’s easy to pick up and deep to master. Charge your heavies, cancel with Force attacks and break your rival’s Focus as five teens with elemental powers take on the Bloodless. Online rollback, local versus, Training and Tutorial.
Can you escape the cursed temple of Quetzalcoatl? In solo or coop, look out for any anomalies. Observe carefully, as any mistake would be fatal!

game_rating.content_survey_notes: Characters will often be killed by traps hidden in levels (such are spikes) and turned to skeleton. The level is also decorated with skeleton, skulls and is overall death themed. Graphics are cartoony and the camera is fairly far away, so nothing looks realistic.

basic_info.short_description:
A boss raid where the boss is also a player!
 A team of 3 guardians, 6 classes, 12 perks.
 An abomination from the 3rd dimension, ready to singlehandedly destroy the world.
 Only 5 minutes until the destruction of the 2nd dimension!
 A casual quirky 1 vs 3 asymmetrical PvP experience: 5 Minute Raid!

Test your precision in 500 CrossBar Challenge! A physics-based football game where only perfect shots matter. Multiple shot types, progressive difficulty, and local multiplayer elimination mode. One target, infinite possibilities. Can you master the crossbar?

5089 is a deep & complex action RPG featuring strong sandbox roots. VR is supported, but not required. Watch the tutorial & VR videos next to the trailer! Everything is procedurally generated, like terrain, enemies, weapons, items & quests. Planet Xax's war rages on... how is that possible?

A physics-based lander about precision flying and chaos. Explore Titan’s mines, land on the Moon, deliver kebabs across space and test your relationship in 2-player “Divorce Mode” with chain-linked spacecraft.

game_rating.content_survey_notes: References to such colloquialisms as 'getting tinned up' and occasional swearing.

basic_info.short_description:
6 takes! - Wolfgang Kramer's ingeniously simple card game with "bullheads".
The aim of the game is to avoid getting cards. The player with the fewest bullheads at the end of the game is the winner. It sounds easier than it is, players will need some great tactics and perhaps a little luck.

A strategic board showdown for 2-4 players. Race to connect six, time your blocks to earn extra tokens, and build lines for power-ups. Play locally, online with friends, or against AI. Every turn pits your plan against everyone else’s. Six wins... technically! Seven earns bragging rights.

Shipwrecked with a girl, fish, cook, gather supplies and brave the weather on a raft. Some catches mutate into monsters: fight them on deck. Decide how to share food and water and whom to help. Get to know her. Will rescue come? Will you reach shore together? What awaits on day 60?

game_rating.content_survey_notes: The game contains anime-style combat, occasional depictions of injury, blood and character death, and some scenes with a tense, dark atmosphere.

basic_info.short_description: Coming of age as a part of the first generation born free, WWII stripped me of my family, home, and future. Now I'm left with only one choice: to get my revenge and independence, or die trying. The odds are against us: will our tactics, stealth and teamwork be enough?

game_rating.content_survey_notes: Violence, blood, dark themes and bad language to be experienced throughout the whole game, as it realistically portraits the War. Torture and killing of the innocent, shown or implied to be present at places. Gore is present in limited amount. Atmosphere may be found scary by some.

basic_info.short_description: Trapped in a haunted Mansion filled with monsters and minigames, you must out maneuver, out think, and out play your friends to escape before your fear makes it impossible to do so.

67 Simulator is a chaotic handtracking Brainrot game. No controllers needed. Use your webcam to play, compete with friends and strangers in Online PvP Modes, climb the Leaderboards, unlock cosmetics and survive ever changing modes.

7 Days Blood Moons is a 4v1 fight to the death. Survivors fortify bases and scavenge for materials while the Zombie Master commands and possesses the horde to crush them. Play solo or with friends – up to 4 survivors can team up against a human or AI Zombie Master. Who will prevail?

7 Days to Die is an open-world game that is a unique combination of first-person shooter, survival horror, tower defense, and role-playing games. Play the definitive zombie survival sandbox RPG that came first. Navezgane awaits!

game_rating.content_survey_notes:
Explicit Violence
Shock and/or Horror Content
Drug Use

basic_info.short_description: 7 Sins is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror game. Search for their items and destroy them in a ritual to stop the creatures. However, whoever touches an item falls victim to the curse of that sin and becomes trapped in mental hallucinations. Resist the curse, solve the mystery, and survive!
